title: Waterloo Park Plan
body:
What's next for Waterloo Park?
We’re creating an updated plan to guide how Waterloo Park will grow and change between now and 2050. This plan will set a big-picture vision for the park's future and identify changes to keep up with the community's needs over time.
Our commitment to you is to plan for the next 25 years of Waterloo Park together!
Project background:
Waterloo Park is an important part of our community. As we update the park plan, we want to learn what matters most to you. Your feedback will help shape seven key themes that will guide the park's future.

FAQ
What is the Waterloo Park Plan and why is it important?
A Park Plan sets out the long-term vision for a park and is used as a strategic roadmap for development and management over the next 25 years.
Having a plan helps the City identify priorities, plan future improvements and allocate resources effectively to meet both current and future community needs.
Why is the Waterloo Park Plan being updated?
The last park plan is from 2009 and is nearing the end of its planning horizon. Plus, the park, surrounding community and City have changed significantly since the plan was adopted.
Many of the recommendations from the 2009 plan have been implemented, including but not limited to the promenade through the park, the updated playgrounds, the new splash pad, and many spots for gathering and picnicking.
What is the scale and scope of the Waterloo Park Plan?
Waterloo Park is roughly 49 hectares of active and passive parkland, centrally located in Waterloo and nestled between the uptown commercial core and the city’s two university campuses, University of Waterloo and Wilfrid Laurier University.
Waterloo Park has been classified as a destination park, meaning it offers various amenities and features to serve both residents and visitors.
View a map of Waterloo Park
.
When will the ideas get implemented?
The final report will propose an implementation strategy, but specific projects will be phased and implemented as funding becomes available.
How will the updated Waterloo Park Plan be funded?
We expect the Waterloo Park Plan to be funded through a combination of City of Waterloo capital funding, future municipal budget allocations, community partnerships, grants and fundraising initiatives.
Some projects may also benefit from being connected to other projects happening in the City, such as recreation, transportation, or environmental improvement projects.
The final report will also identify potential funding sources and implementation strategies; however, it is expected that the plan will be carried out in phases over time.
This phased approach will allow projects to proceed as funding opportunities arise and resources become available, ensuring that improvements can be delivered in a financially sustainable manner.
